en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a lakeside town with many early 20th‑century buildings and a wooded hill across the water. In the foreground stands a substantial brick building with a steep tiled roof, seen above treetops. Printed white text at the bottom identifies the scene as a view of Östersund from the town hall and credits the photography company A/B Almquist & Cöster from Hälsingborg, along with a small oval logo reading "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI".
